svg.title: Two publics: OpenAI leads everyone else, Anthropic leads the people who build with AI
svg.desc: ChatGPT has 40× as many US App Store ratings as Claude (10,883,936 against 271,740). 39% of professional developers used Claude Code at work against 16% for OpenAI's Codex. Across 16 measures, Anthropic's share of the two-company total runs from 2.4% (US iOS ratings) to 70.9% (Agent at work).
